fields.Name: Spektrix Data Feeds
fields.Description: Spektrix Data Feeds — the WCF customer feed (IDataFeed.GetCustomerData) that carries the bulk customer base the v3 REST API does not expose. Read-only, windowed by last-updated date, with a per-connection personal-data policy (raw / pseudonymize / suppress) applied before any row lands.

Configuration.Transport: SOAP 1.1 over MTOM (multipart/related) to https://api.system.spektrix.com/{ClientName}/api/datafeeds/datafeeds.svc; customer records are a length-framed .NET BinaryFormatter (MS-NRBF) stream.
Configuration.TransportClient: Integrator-supplied streaming Node client for the Data Feeds protocol, registered by the host via RegisterSpektrixDataFeedClientFactory; this package never imports it.
Configuration.AuthScheme: TLS client certificate (PKCS#12). The certificate is issued per integrator and may grant access to many Spektrix systems; it must stay where its holder runs the client.

OperationsKnownOutOfScope.reason: not yet covered by the TypeScript client; sales rows wait on it
catalogue data already covered by the Spektrix v3 connector

Configuration.IncrementalSyncCapability: GetCustomerData takes From/To and returns customers whose DateLastUpdated falls in the range; the connector walks date windows and stores the window end as the watermark.
Configuration.PaginationCapability: None at the service; the connector pages a buffered window by cursor.

RateLimits.guidance: One request in flight; the service prepares the whole window before sending the first byte, which can take minutes.

Configuration.DeleteSemantics: No deletion feed. Customer merges arrive as (from, to, date) pointers and are kept as rows, never applied as deletes.

PersonalDataPolicy.appliedAt: FetchChanges, before the record reaches the engine (overflow, snapshot, content hash and field maps all see the policy output)

Configuration.DeclaredAgainst: Data Feeds client types 0.1.0 (2026-11-03), decoding Spektrix.DataFeeds.Data.Person / Organisation / Address / Attribute

fields.Name: Customer
fields.Description: A Spektrix customer record (Person or Organisation) from the Data Feeds customer stream. One row per customer; the `type` column tells the two apart and the address columns come from Person.BillingAddress or Organisation.PrimaryAddress. Read incrementally by last-updated date window.
